logger.doc:name: Log processing
logger.message: #['[FLOW4] Processing | deviceId: ' ++ (payload.deviceId default 'N/A') ++ ' | metric: ' ++ (payload.metricName default 'N/A') ++ ' | value: ' ++ (payload.value as String default '0')]

db:insert.doc:name: Upsert sensor_readings
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO sensor_readings (device_id, metric_name, reading_timestamp, metric_value, unit, quality_flag, breach_status, site_id, firmware_version, ingested_at, correlation_id) VALUES (:deviceId, :metricName, :readingTimestamp, :metricValue, :unit, :qualityFlag, :breachStatus, :siteId, :firmwareVersion, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, :correlationId) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE metric_value = VALUES(metric_value), unit = VALUES(unit), quality_flag = VALUES(quality_flag), breach_status = VALUES(breach_status), site_id = VALUES(site_id), firmware_version = VALUES(firmware_version), ingested_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, correlation_id = VALUES(correlation_id)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ deviceId: payload.deviceId, metricName: payload.metricName, readingTimestamp: payload.readingTimestamp, metricValue: payload.value, unit: payload.unit, qualityFlag: payload.quality, breachStatus: payload.breachStatus, siteId: payload.siteId default "", firmwareVersion: payload.firmwareVersion default "", correlationId: payload.correlationId default "" }]

logger.doc:name: Log DB failure
logger.message: #['[FLOW4] DB failed — calling DLQ handler | metric: ' ++ (vars.currentReading.metricName default 'N/A') ++ ' | error: ' ++ error.description]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- { correlationId: vars.currentReading.correlationId default "N/A", deviceId: vars.currentReading.deviceId default "N/A", siteId: vars.currentReading.siteId default "N/A", firmwareVersion: vars.currentReading.firmwareVersion default "N/A", reading: vars.currentReading, failedAt: now() as String, errorType: error.errorType.identifier, reason: "DB unavailable — reading stored in DLQ for retry" }

db:insert.doc:name: Update sensor_current_value if newer
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO sensor_current_value (device_id, metric_name, metric_value, unit, reading_timestamp, breach_status, updated_at) VALUES (:deviceId, :metricName, :metricValue, :unit, :readingTimestamp, :breachStatus, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE metric_value = IF(VALUES(reading_timestamp) > reading_timestamp, VALUES(metric_value), metric_value), unit = IF(VALUES(reading_timestamp) > reading_timestamp, VALUES(unit), unit), breach_status = IF(VALUES(reading_timestamp) > reading_timestamp, VALUES(breach_status), breach_status), updated_at = IF(VALUES(reading_timestamp) > reading_timestamp, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at), reading_timestamp = IF(VALUES(reading_timestamp) > reading_timestamp, VALUES(reading_timestamp), reading_timestamp)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ deviceId: payload.deviceId, metricName: payload.metricName, metricValue: payload.value, unit: payload.unit, readingTimestamp: payload.readingTimestamp, breachStatus: payload.breachStatus }]

logger.doc:name: Acknowledge successful processing
logger.message: #['[FLOW4] Complete | deviceId: ' ++ (vars.readingEnvelope.deviceId default 'N/A') ++ ' | metric: ' ++ (vars.readingEnvelope.metricName default 'N/A') ++ ' | success: ' ++ (payload.successfulRecords as String) ++ ' | failed: ' ++ (payload.failedRecords as String) ++ ' | duration(ms): ' ++ (payload.elapsedTimeInMillis as String default '0')]
